text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to make some snacks for Super
Creek to have during her training
breaks, I decide to go
out and shop for
various ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Goodness gracious, look at all of the
stuff you
have... Are you planning a
party or something?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I would have cooked for you if you had
just told
me. Please remember that you
can ask me for
anything, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry? You're saying that's for me?
choice_data_list: I thought you could eat it during ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nutrient intake during training is
necessary to improve strength and
stamina. And I figured a
tasty treat
wouldn't hurt either.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You're planning to make the snacks
yourself
instead of just buying nutrition
bars?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Goodness me! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm only who I am today because you're
always
working so hard for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You study so hard, are super
considerate, and
give me tons of energy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Which means I must find some way to
repay you!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
A gift of gratitude full of love to soothe
your
body and soul... Hehe! ♪
